projections.title: SPACE THEATRE COMPONENT (STC) PROGRAMME SENIOR MANAGEMENT SUPPORT
projections.description: NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-27-01 LABOR CATEGORY 26: SPACE THEATRE COMPONENT (STC) PROGRAMME SENIOR MANAGEMENT SUPPORT Location: Ramstein, Germany (On-site) Number of Candidates: One (1) candidate required Period of Performance: Base Period: Award – 31 December 2026 with four potential 12 – month options Option Year 1: 1 January 2027 – 31 December 2027 Option Year 2: 1 January 2028 – 31 December 2028 Option Year 3: 1 January 2029 – 31 December 2029 Option Year 4: 1 January 2030 – 31 December 2030 Tasking 1. Support the ACT Space Branch PMT in the delivery, synchronization, and implementation of the NATO Space Capability Programme (CPP) across all tranches and associated projects. 2. Support Space Theatre Component (STC) in integrating NATO Space capabilities into Space operational planning and execution activities. 3. Coordinate operational requirements and user feedback between STC, SHAPE, ACT, NCIA, NSPA, and national space organizations. 4. Support the development, refinement, and implementation of programme artefacts, including project proposals, implementation plans, programme reviews, risk registers, dashboards, and capability roadmaps. 5. Support operational validation of CPP capabilities and their integration into NATO command-and-control structures. 6. Support the synchronization of Operational Space Support (OSS), Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Space Domain Coordination (SDC) capabilities and associated dependencies. 7. Assist in the development of operational procedures, playbooks and coordination mechanisms for space-enabled operations including Space capabilities considerations. 8. Support training, exercises and experimentation activities involving space capabilities. 9. Contribute to programme governance activities, PMT meetings, Bi-SC coordination mechanisms, and senior leader engagements. 10. Assist with the identification and prioritization of operational capability gaps and associated requirements. 11. Contribute to the assessment of operational impacts and lessons learned related to the employment of space capabilities. NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-27-01 12. Support the identification, analysis and mitigation of programme risks, interdependencies, and critical paths across all space projects. 13. Support NATO exercises, operational experimentation, evaluations, and lessons learned activities involving Space capabilities. 14. Support experimentation, wargaming, operational demonstrations and exercises, including Arctic Sentry, Cosmic Sentinel, and/or related activities. 15. Contribute to operational acceptance activities, readiness assessments, and transition planning. 16. Support engagement with industry and commercial space actors in support of NATO Commercial Space Strategy implementation. 17. Prepare briefings, analyses, and recommendations for STC leadership and support the PMT efforts and briefings. 18. Directly supports the STC and will be required to travel to meetings and conferences both within and outside NATO’s boundaries for up to 30 days per year. 19. Performs additional tasks as required by the COTR (in HQ SACT) in close coordination with the STC leadership related to the LABOR category. Essential Qualifications 1. University degree in systems engineering, computer science, aerospace engineering, or related discipline (five years of experience accepted in lieu). 2. Minimum 5 years’ experience within NATO capability development, programme management, or defence acquisition. 3. Minimum 3 years of operational experience within NATO or national space operations. 4. Demonstrated experience in space operations integration within NATO or national commands. 5. Demonstrated knowledge of NATO Space policy, CPP governance and PMT processes. 6. Demonstrate a minimum of 3 years operational knowledge of C2 systems within the last 10 years either as a military officer or as a civilian. 7. Experience supporting multinational programmes and senior-level governance bodies. 8. Programme and Project Management experience in the past 10 years within a complex and dynamic programme environment. 9. Working knowledge of Configuration Management methods and practices. NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-27-01 10. Working knowledge of Capability Architectures 11. Experience with IBM Rational DOORS or equivalent (provide certificates). NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-27-01 Annex B Requirements Matrix Contractors’ technical proposals will be assessed on the qualifications of both the company and individuals proposed to perform the work. Individuals’ résumés will be measured against each of the criteria specified below to ascertain whether the individuals have adequate qualifications to be considered compliant. (HQ SACT reserves the right to conduct technical discussions of nominated candidates). Examples of how detailed knowledge levels were attained are expected. Ultimately Contractor companies shall clearly demonstrate by providing unequivocal reference to where company/key personnel meet the criteria set forth in this solicitation (please include page number, reference to CV or links as applicable).
